tasks.name: policy_valid
tasks.description: Determines if the policy is valid given the claim

task_specific_config.expression: (function () { const claimDetails = $.claim_details; if (claimDetails.get("policy_picker")) { const policyType = $.policyTypes.find(p => p["const"] === claimDetails.get("policy_picker")); return policyType?.title === "AUTO" ? "yes" : "policy-not-valid"; } return "policy-not-valid" }())

decisionCases.yes: Policy is AUTO type - proceed with claim processing

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: SWITCH task - Translate to Python if/else. Validates policy type is AUTO. Yes case contains nested workflow (createClaimForPolicy, assesor_findings, incident_covered_by_policy). Default case terminates workflow.

tasks.name: createClaimForPolicy
tasks.description: Persists the claim in the database for the given policy
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Simple activity inside policy_valid SWITCH yes case. Creates claim record in database.

tasks.name: human
tasks.description: Asessor fills in finding from the place of the event
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: HUMAN_TASK inside policy_valid yes case. Assessor enters findings from incident site. Use Update handler with validation. Returns multiple output fields including assessment details and location.

tasks.name: incident_covered_by_policy
tasks.description: Determine if the incident is covered by the policy

decisionCases.yes: Incident is covered - calculate damage and proceed

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Nested SWITCH inside policy_valid yes case. Checks if overall_coverage is not 'Not Covered'. Yes case contains damage calculation, cost check, and potential investigation. Default case terminates.

tasks.name: determine_price_of_damage
tasks.description: Calculate the price of the damage

input_parameters.expression: (function () { const costMap = { "Side collision Damage": 2500, "Minor front door damage": 500, "Windshield Damage": 1000 }; const items = $.assesor_findings.map(va => { const estimated_cost = costMap[va.get("damage_type")]; return ({ description: va.get("damage_type"), estimated_cost, coverage: va.get("coverage_determination"), covered_percentage: va.get("coverage_score") }); }); const totalCost = items.reduce((acc, { estimated_cost, coverage,covered_percentage }) => { const total_damage_cost = acc.total_damage_cost + estimated_cost; if (coverage === "Not covered") { const total_non_covered_cost = acc.total_non_covered_cost + estimated_cost; return ({ total_covered_cost: acc.total_covered_cost, total_non_covered_cost, total_damage_cost }); } const vaPercent = Number(covered_percentage) / 100; const totalToPay = estimated_cost * vaPercent; const total_covered_cost = acc.total_covered_cost + totalToPay; return ({ total_covered_cost, total_non_covered_cost: acc.total_non_covered_cost, total_damage_cost }); }, { total_covered_cost: 0, total_non_covered_cost: 0, total_damage_cost: 0 }); return { "damage_estimation": { "total_damage_cost": totalCost.total_damage_cost, "items": items }, "coverage_calculation": { "total_covered_cost": totalCost.total_covered_cost, "total_non_covered_cost": totalCost.total_non_covered_cost, "explanation": $.asessor_rationale } } })();

damage_estimation.items: Array of damage items with costs

task_specific_config.calculation_logic: Maps damage types to costs, calculates coverage percentages, aggregates totals

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Complex INLINE task inside incident_covered_by_policy yes case. Implement as Python function in workflow. Calculates damage costs using predefined cost map, applies coverage percentages, aggregates totals. Pure data transformation - no activity needed.

tasks.name: exceed_cost
tasks.description: Does the damage exceed a suspicious cost
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Nested SWITCH inside incident_covered_by_policy yes case. Checks if total_covered_cost > 100. Yes case triggers investigation HUMAN task. After switch, workflow proceeds to terminate_ref_2 for completion.

tasks.name: human
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: HUMAN_TASK inside exceed_cost yes case (deep nesting level 4). On-site investigation form for high-cost claims. Use Update handler.

tasks.name: after_investigation_is_it_covered
tasks.description: Given the new findings is the claim really covered
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Deeply nested SWITCH (level 4) inside exceed_cost yes case. Re-evaluates coverage after investigation. Default case contains TERMINATE task. Note: References incident_covered_by_policy_ref.output.covered but this is not clearly set - may need clarification or use investigation findings.

tasks.name: terminate
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: TERMINATE task in after_investigation_is_it_covered default case. Return failure result from workflow with termination reason.

tasks.name: terminate_2
tasks.description: Terminated send the payment to the client
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Success TERMINATE task after exceed_cost processing. This executes after the exceed_cost SWITCH completes (regardless of yes/default case). Return success result from workflow.

tasks.name: terminate_1

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: TERMINATE task in incident_covered_by_policy default case. Return failure result from workflow.

tasks.name: terminate_by_invalid_policy

complexity_factors: Deep nesting: 5 levels (policy_valid -> incident_covered_by_policy -> exceed_cost -> investigation -> after_investigation -> terminate)
Multiple nested SWITCH tasks: 4 SWITCH tasks at different nesting levels
3 HUMAN_TASK tasks requiring external input and state management
2 complex INLINE tasks with significant JavaScript logic for data transformation
Multiple termination paths with different outcomes (4 TERMINATE tasks)
Complex data flow: outputs from early tasks used deep in nested structures
Conditional branching at each level affects overall execution path significantly

recommended_patterns.human_interaction: Updates recommended for all 3 HUMAN tasks (take_claim_ref, assesor_findings_ref, investigation_human_ref) with validation and timeout handling. Consider implementing escalation logic for timeouts.
recommended_patterns.error_handling: Add RetryPolicy to findPolicyForCustomer and createClaimForPolicy activities (database operations). Consider non-retryable failures for invalid policy scenarios.
recommended_patterns.parallel_execution: No parallel execution in current workflow. All tasks are sequential or nested in conditional branches.
recommended_patterns.loop_handling: No loops present in this workflow.
